description: A screen whose source has nothing to list yet (the claude adapter's sessions glob matches no file) is an empty screen, not a refusal: an empty glob or a missing file reads as empty. Resuming may restart the agent, so the picker carries onSelectConfirm. Harness deviation: a fake `claude` on PATH prints version 2.1.319 and idles; the claude adapter's transcript feed reads testdata/claude/transcript-basic.jsonl, and the anchor marker reports epoch "e1" with fixed offsets.
